rule.name: HashOrderAssertedInTest
rule.message: This assertion expects a fixed order from a value whose order nothing promises: a HashSet, a HashMap view, Set.of or Map.of, Collectors.toSet(), a directory listing or the members reflection returns. It passes on one JDK, file system or machine and fails on another. Use containsExactlyInAnyOrder, compare with a Set, or sort the value before the assertion (Arrays.sort for an array).
